case_name: Page No. 1/4 vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 26 August, 2022

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Anil Singh and Sri Sunil Singh (S/O. Lt. Kairang Singh)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Assam and 4 Ors (Rep. by the Comm. and Secy. to the Govt. of Assam, Deptt. of Power) and others

facts_of_case: Two petitioners are born out of a marriage with one Smt. Radha Rani Sinha. Kairang Singh retired from service on 31.10.2015. He expired on 12.12.2015. The issue involved is distribution of gratuity amount.

legal_principles.principle: Gratuity payable to nominee or heirs of deceased employee.
legal_principles.held: The second proviso to Section 4 [1] has provided that in case of death of the employee, gratuity payable to him shall be paid to his nominee or, if no nomination has been made, to his heirs, or where any such nominee or heir is a minor, the share of such minor, shall be deposited with the Controlling Authority.

legal_principles.principle: When a minor is involved, the share of such minor shall be deposited with the Controlling Authority.
legal_principles.held: where any such nominee or heir is a minor, the share of such minor, shall be deposited with the Controlling Authority who shall invest the same for the benefit of such minor in such bank or other financial institution or as may be prescribed, until such minor attains majority.

outcome.final_order: The court has emerged that the issue involved is distribution of gratuity amount of one Late Kairang Singh, an employee in the respondent Assam Power Distribution Company Limited [APDCL], who died intestate.

use_for_drafting: advising on joint family property disputes
representing clients in Hindu succession cases
